followup_nonnegative_fit.motivation: All 102 unconstrained fits in 30273030 were inadmissible. This explicitly recorded follow-up tests whether enforcing nonnegative radii resolves that failure; no downstream values are used.
followup_nonnegative_fit.fit: Exact two-parameter nonnegative least squares of (3/8)*ell_um^2 = a*log(D/D_lower)+c, a,c>=0; fit training blocks only.
followup_nonnegative_fit.support: R^2 may approach zero at the declared lower endpoint, but must be strictly positive for every included observed diameter; no clipping or data removal.
followup_nonnegative_fit.reporting: Retain original unconstrained fits and all check results. This adaptive follow-up is not a blind physical validation.
